idea-plugin.name: Loji Notes
idea-plugin.description:
Loji Notes — floating, draggable comment cards pinned to any code line, connected back to the anchor by a leader line. Notes live in .loji/notes/ inside the repository, so they travel with git and show up on every machine that clones the project.

给代码某一行挂一张可拖动、可换色、可折叠的注释卡，用指向线连回它批注的那一行。

What it does / 能做什么

  • Drag anywhere / 自由摆放：按住卡片拖到任意位置，松手即存。
  • Leader line / 指向线：曲线从卡片连到锚点行尾；锚点滚出可视区时卡片自动隐藏。
  • Six colors / 六色：右键切换；点小三角收成一条，省屏幕。
  • Follows the code / 跟着代码走：锚点 = 行号 + 行指纹 + 上下各 2 行上下文，代码挪动后自动重新定位；真找不到就标「锚点丢失」，不会乱指。
  • Team friendly / 跨机器：数据是纯文本 JSON，提交进版本库即可多人共享。

Shortcuts / 快捷键

  • Ctrl+Alt+N 在光标行新建注释栏 / new note on the current line
  • Ctrl+Alt+Shift+N 全局收起或展开 / toggle all cards
  • 双击卡片改文字，右键换色 / 收起 / 跳到锚点行 / 删除

Where the data lives / 数据在哪

<project>/.loji/notes/<relative path>.json — plain text, diffable, mergeable. The plugin does not use the network and collects no data; uninstalling it leaves those files untouched.

Requirements / 要求

IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 or newer. Built against the 2026.2 editor API.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0 — first public build.

  • Draggable cards with leader lines, six colors, collapse, global toggle
  • Sidecar storage in .loji/notes/, shared through git
  • Anchor fingerprinting with automatic re-location
  • Scroll synchronisation: cards follow the code, off-screen anchors hide the card
